title: nfl.com publishes no spreads, totals or moneylines
detail: The league's official site carries no betting prices, and no operator publishes a public, machine-readable, timestamped price history. The price store therefore has empty MARKET_OPEN and MARKET_CLOSE rows for every market we originate.
consequence: Closing-line value, ROI at a real price, and demotion triggers D1a, D1b and D1f are all unmeasurable today.
action: Capture an operator price page on a fixed schedule and record the raw snapshot with a UTC timestamp, or accept that no strategy can ever be certified.

title: The pinned mirror lags the official results feed
detail: Of 137 official 2026 finals, the mirror agrees on 136 and disagrees on 0; 1 game is final on nfl.com but still unscored in the mirror.
consequence: Any desk that reads scores from the mirror is up to several days behind the official page.
action: Keep nfl.com as the results source of record and treat the mirror as a cross-check only.

title: The Week 11 official injury report is not published yet
detail: Requesting the Week 11 report returns the Week 10 report; the only week tabs offered are 1 through 10. The report needed to price Week 11 does not exist.
consequence: Every Week 11 market is originated with no injury or replacement-depth adjustment.
action: Re-run the pipeline once the league publishes the Week 11 report; the adjustment column is already wired.

title: Depth charts are one club short and one day old
detail: 31 of 32 clubs publish a readable depth chart. Houston publishes its chart only as a raster image, so it contributes no rows rather than a guessed set. The snapshot was taken 2026-11-13.
consequence: Houston's replacement depth is unknown, and any club that edited its chart after the snapshot is stale.
action: Re-fetch weekly and fail closed (blank plus flag) for clubs that do not publish machine-readable charts.

title: Every bet is graded at a flat -110
detail: The mirror carries no per-leg prices for the 2026 season, so each graded bet is scored at the standard -110 convention with a 52.38% break-even.
consequence: Real prices vary by side and by game; ROI figures are indicative, not a statement of what a bet would have paid.
action: Replace with captured operator prices as soon as any exist (F-01).

title: No player-prop lines exist from any source in this repo
detail: Neither nfl.com nor the mirror publishes player-prop lines. The prop-combo family therefore produced no graded bets, and gate G7 cannot be satisfied for any parlay or prop combination.
consequence: Two of the three bet classes in the brief cannot be priced at all.
action: Source prop lines with timestamps, or keep S9 on the board as an explicit, unpriceable entry.

title: The totals model does not beat a naive league-average baseline
detail: Out-of-sample on 2026 weeks 5-10: totals MAE 11.0038 points against 11.0235 for simply predicting the league average total every game.
consequence: Half of the origination chain (the total) currently adds no forecast value, and the moneyline inherits that.
action: Rebuild the totals model before trusting any total or moneyline we originate; see suggestion SG-02.

title: The certification universe is far smaller than gate G1 requires
detail: The official feed holds 137 games. After the walk-forward warm-up, each family produced between 4 and 51 graded bets on the certification board, against a 300-bet minimum.
consequence: Nothing on the certification board can be certified this season, whatever its hit rate.
action: Accumulate seasons of official results, or lower G1 explicitly and record the increased false-discovery risk.

title: Most official injury rows carry no game status at retrieval
detail: The Week 10 report lists 326 players; only 25 carry a game status early in the week. Game statuses are published later in the week.
consequence: The replacement-depth tracker can only use practice status for the other players, so 'out' is under-counted early in the week.
action: Re-read the report on Friday and again on Saturday; the tracker keys off game status and will change as it fills in.

title: The aggregator reference line has no timestamp
detail: The mirror supplies one line per game per market with no snapshot time. The store records it as MARKET_REFERENCE, never as MARKET_OPEN or MARKET_CLOSE.
consequence: Any 'we beat the line by X' statement computed against it could be measuring a stale early-week price.
action: Do not quote a CLV number against it; the desk uses it only as a difference column.

title: Cross-desk drift in earlier NFL desks (not edited here)
detail: The d38e90c5 repo audit found a corrupted depth_crosscheck column and a mixed signal/staking leaderboard in nfl-desk-864d5668, third-party ESPN/DraftKings prices in nfl-desk-26d4cafb, and frozen 2026-11-02 ledgers in nfl-strategy-lab and line-lab.
consequence: Those files belong to other sessions' claims and are not represented as verified here.
action: Logged for the owning sessions and the final integration session; not edited by this session.

title: Pre-existing failing workflows on main (outside this session's scope)
detail: Two workflows fail on main at their deterministic generated-output checks: the NFL Decision Desk fetch/verify and the B34 Week 10 research desk. They are pre-existing and not caused by this session.
consequence: Those desks' CI is red; this desk's own scoped workflow is independent.
action: Logged for the owning sessions; not edited here.
